actions.title: Add a bulk-despawn method to EnemyField3D and call it from _clear_run before replaying a load, so a load doesn't leave a desynced live horde.
Author a per-mission wave_cap or explicit win predicate; campaign mode currently has no reachable win condition.

Give Hordes a scripts/sync-audit-dashboard.ps1 (mirroring Scheduler's) and have nightly-sweep call it after every audit, independent of release.ps1.

Re-run the auto-enqueue for the 2026-08-10 report's 187 findings, which never reached .work-queue.json at all; add an assertion that fails loudly when actionsOpen>0 but zero matching queue rows exist.
Add a hard per-run auto-enqueue cap to 05_meta_synthesis.md; the mechanism can still dump 187+ findings into the queue in one run.
Derive the enqueue key from finding content (evidence hash) not ordinal position; restrict live-queue dedup to non-terminal statuses; add a .work-queue-archive.json lookup.
Republish code-audit's HTBH.md hazard file from personal-skills-src; the loaded copy still describes the retired pre-v0.98.5 2D stack with zero mentions of source/world3d/.
Give check_source_integrity.py a signal that still blocks a dirty file when a FUSE-truncation pattern coincides with the diff tail, instead of soft-skipping every dirty file.
In _load_run, suppress the per-item navmesh bake and call _region.bake_navigation_mesh(false) once after the restore loop.
Add a techs_done key to _save_run's payload and repopulate _techs_done from it at the top of _load_run, before UI can call _research_tech.
Clear economy._warehouses in reset_to_defaults() and _clear_run(), or filter get_cap() by is_instance_valid(), so the storage cap stops inflating on every reload.
Replace raw KEY_* branches in world_3d._unhandled_input and iso_cam_3d with Input.is_action_just_pressed against input_defaults so rebinding a hotkey actually works.
Add a HUD toast helper driven by options.get_toast_duration_seconds() for placement/train/research refusals; stop placement_3d.cancel()-ing the whole build session on a failed afford check.
Wire the power branch of _on_building_placed to economy.register_power_supply/register_power_draw; all five power buildings currently do nothing.
Wrap game_hud.gd's hardcoded player-facing strings in tr(), or record a superseding decision admitting deferred tr() coverage.
Fix or delete background.tscn's dead texture reference; it renders at full opacity on the live settings screen.
Rewrite mission 1's blurb into operator-brief register and author blurbs for missions 2-6, which still ship with no text.
Add an in-fiction subtitle under VICTORY/DEFEAT naming the locked severed-portal consequence on loss.
Check save map_size against the live world before restoring positions on an F9/pause-menu load; a mismatched map size currently applies blind.

Parse the newest CANONICAL_AUDIT-*.md for real HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW counts instead of re-emitting the previous findings value unchanged.
Batch the seven unworked audit-loop-integrity queue items into one attended session; a single GDD pill bump discharges all of them together.
Exempt the newest report of each type from retention pruning, or rewrite orphaned queue items' source field; 204 of 215 HBH queue items cite a deleted report file.
Add a reverse-reconciliation leg to the post-write gate: list non-terminal queue finding_ids missing from openFindings.
Delete or re-point the stale anthropic-skills bar-raise snapshot; it is registered alongside the current copy with diverged, out-of-date content.
Rebuild personal-skills.plugin from personal-skills-src (currently v0.1.0 on disk vs v0.5.1 in source); bar-raise, code-audit, and 3 other skills are missing from the intended namespace entirely.
Rewrite work-queue-runner's documented kind/project/status enums from the actual 24/29/5-value live vocabulary; almost none of the documented enum values match reality.
Copy finding evidence into the queue item at enqueue time; consolidate-audit-files.ps1 hard-deletes older report files with zero awareness of open queue items that cite them.

Route publish-gdd.ps1, write-dashboard-status.ps1, and sync-erik-branch.ps1's git writes through the now-existing Invoke-Git wrapper; only push-to-github.ps1 uses it today.

Have discord-notify.ps1 log failures to a durable file and have release.ps1 check its exit code; a Discord post failure is currently invisible to the pipeline.
Add a pre-commit check that fails when source/scripts changed but the GDD version pill didn't move; two 2026-07-24 commits reused an already-claimed version label.

barRaise.reconcileNote: Full 35-lens pass 2026-07-30, CATCH-UP for the missed 2026-07-29 window (48.5h since the 2026-07-28 carry-forward; no BAR_RAISE-2026-07-29.md exists). Skip-unchanged gate did NOT fire: 2 commits since the last review (3487e94 v0.99.41, 533edd4 status-writer utf-8 fix), tree clean, both hard_rule_checks re-verified from disk (GDD tail </html> on 1,664,229 bytes; colorblind_mode once in options.gd). No BLOCK: zero lenses returned blocking true. Health 71 to 66. actionsOpen 118 to 187, driven by 35 lenses running for the first time since 2026-07-25 and finding 71 new items; actionsClosed 1 (scale-architecture-02). Chronic 116 of 187. The headline is that v0.99.41's dev-economy retirement made the real cap economy live and it does not fit: 4 mineral caps at 50 against 11 buildings and 4 research techs priced above, register_warehouse uncalled, and no SAVE_VERSION bump so pre-2026-07-24 saves clamp silently. Two apparatus-integrity findings matter for reading any of this: audit-hordes-nightly died on an API 500 at 2026-07-30T06:07Z and wrote nothing while lastRunAt was stamped clean, and the 2026-07-29 bar-raise was dropped inside a 9h40m global_limit dead zone after a MemoryExhaustion crash. Four HIGH findings across skill-suite-health, skill-trigger-collisions, incident-runbook-currency and skill-chain-handoff-integrity share one root cause: the executing personal-skills plugin snapshot is v0.1.0 against a v0.5.1 source.
